title: Code Mode capability token claims
description: The claims of the capability token the broker issues for one execution, bound to the codemode.execute request that started it (request_id), the program (code_digest) and the sandbox instance that holds it (sandbox_id). The broker accepts it only from that sandbox, only for the listed actions (each still checked against the actor's own grants, so the token narrows and never widens them), up to max_calls calls in total and only before expires_at; codemode actions are never listed, so a program cannot start another execution with a fresh budget. Each run of an execution, its start and every resume, gets a fresh token bound to that run's codemode.execute request_id, and a spent token_id is refused. The token carries no credential for any lab system; handlers resolve their own secrets.
